diagnostics.opsinEvidence: Exploratory 3-state anion-channel model. Approximate 40 ms off-scale from ACR literature; other rates and spectrum are assumed. Soma targeting is a separate expression control, not a different ionic mechanism.

opsinParameters.name: GtACR2-like chloride · reduced
opsinParameters.reference: Mahn et al. 2018; Messier et al. 2018; Govorunova et al. 2018
opsinParameters.evidence: Exploratory 3-state anion-channel model. Approximate 40 ms off-scale from ACR literature; other rates and spectrum are assumed. Soma targeting is a separate expression control, not a different ionic mechanism.

limitations: Cells are rotated/translated copies of one fitted human model, not distinct biological cell types. No synapses, ephaptic coupling or collision physics.
The original cell has a synthetic axon stub; chloride in that stub is an assumption, not measured anatomy.
Reduced opsin kinetics and off-peak action spectra are exploratory, not independently fitted experimental models.
Chloride uses independent well-mixed local pools, finite geometry-derived volume and a relaxation surrogate for transport; no axial ionic diffusion, bicarbonate or extracellular depletion.

Event reduction compares counts inside the illuminated intervals with an identical-drive dark control. Negative reduction means more events; it does not prove causal inhibition or account for all post-light effects.
Williams ChR2 was characterized at −80 to −10 mV and 0.34–5.5 mW/mm². Rest/AP voltages and some LED-site exposures extrapolate the fit; no recruitment accuracy is established.
The inherited 40→20 µm voltage/spike convergence limitation remains. Thermal feedback is not included.
